experiment.answers: the blind spot three consecutive receipts named and none closed -- 'catching it needs a check that reads through THE SAME PATH THE COMPUTATION USES, meaning the DEVICE computing a digest of its own memory'

device.reason: MOCK external domain; no external GPU exists and §21 forbids citing a simulated transport number as physical evidence

model.reason: a fabric experiment; no model executed

headline: The device now digests its own memory through the path a KERNEL reads, and compute_skew -- which passed every previous version of the check -- is CAUGHT. But this is a NARROWING, not a closure, and the control proves it: a provider that digests its READ-BACK path exposes an identical API, answers, matches the source, and a kernel still reads different bytes.

WHAT_CLOSED.before: the integrity check compared the SOURCE with what copy_out RETURNS, so it validated THE ROUND TRIP and not the resident copy. On a real bridge copy_out and a kernel are not the same path.
WHAT_CLOSED.after: MockExternalMemoryProvider.digest_resident computes blake2b-128 over read_for_compute -- the same path a kernel uses -- and the fabric compares it against the source's identity digest before marking the copy CLEAN.

demonstrated.honest_provider_with_compute_skew: RAISES 'RESIDENT integrity check FAILED', destination out of valid_copies()
demonstrated.the_round_trip_check_PASSED_the_same_cas: so the two checks are independent, not two views of one; corrupt_next still fires on the round-trip check alone and the resident digest would never see it, pinned by its own test

WHY_IT_IS_A_NARROWING_AND_NOT_A_CLOSURE.the_control: ReadbackDigestProvider offers digest_resident, answers it, and returns a digest that MATCHES THE SOURCE -- because it digests copy_out. With compute_skew armed the transfer completes, the state is CLEAN, resident_verified is TRUE, and read_for_compute still returns different bytes.
WHY_IT_IS_A_NARROWING_AND_NOT_A_CLOSURE.what_that_establishes: the check's strength is a property of THE DEVICE'S IMPLEMENTATION, not of the fabric's protocol. Two providers indistinguishable through the API give opposite guarantees. THE FABRIC CANNOT VERIFY THE CLAIM, so resident_digest_path is RECORDED rather than trusted and resident_verified is unreadable without it -- a test asserts True and 'readback' together on a copy a kernel would misread.
WHY_IT_IS_A_NARROWING_AND_NOT_A_CLOSURE.the_blind_spot_moved_rather_than_vanishi: from 'copy_out is not a kernel' to 'the digest kernel may not be the compute kernel'. The second is narrower AND it is a stated device property somebody can ask a vendor about, where the first was an unconditional hole.
WHY_IT_IS_A_NARROWING_AND_NOT_A_CLOSURE.absence_is_not_failure: a provider with no digest_resident gets resident_verified False and path None, and the transfer still succeeds -- absence of the capability is absence of evidence, and the two fields say which. Pinned by a test.

THE_COST_ARGUMENT_IS_ARITHMETIC_NOT_A_ME.the_structural_point: a round-trip check must bring the WHOLE PAYLOAD back across the link; a resident digest brings back SIXTEEN BYTES.
THE_COST_ARGUMENT_IS_ARITHMETIC_NOT_A_ME.and_it_does_NOT_follow_that_the_resident: the device still has to digest the payload. The resident check wins iff THE DEVICE'S DIGEST THROUGHPUT EXCEEDS THE LINK BANDWIDTH -- transport saved is B/R, digest paid is B/D, so the condition is simply D > R.
THE_COST_ARGUMENT_IS_ARITHMETIC_NOT_A_ME.using_the_only_digest_rates_this_program: blake2b-128 at 1.387 GB/s (host, from ACCELERATOR_HUMF_IDENTITY.json) digests 24 MiB in 18.14 ms. A device digesting at THAT rate LOSES to the round trip by 1.44x on a 2 GB/s link, 3.60x at 5 GB/s and 28.84x at 40 GB/s. A device digesting at unified-memory bandwidth would take 0.043 ms and win ~118x at 5 GB/s -- BUT THAT RATE IS HYPOTHETICAL AND UNMEASURED HERE.
THE_COST_ARGUMENT_IS_ARITHMETIC_NOT_A_ME.the_honest_caution: blake2b is a SERIAL chain per block, so a naive device implementation does NOT reach memory bandwidth and the favourable branch is not automatic. What is established is the CONDITION D > R, not which side of it a real bridge lands on.
THE_COST_ARGUMENT_IS_ARITHMETIC_NOT_A_ME.it_also_converges_with_the_identity_bloc: that receipt measured a host re-hash costing MORE THAN THE MOVE and resolved it with identity_recheck_age. Moving the digest to the device attacks the blind spot AND the affordability problem with one change -- if D > R holds, which is exactly the thing not measured.

an_artifact_of_the_mock_named_rather_tha: in this mock the fabric learns the destination payload BY CALLING copy_out, so the return leg is not optional here and the transport saving is a statement about a REAL bridge where the destination is not read back at all. Saying that beats quoting a saving the mock does not actually realise.

claim_boundary: MOCK ONLY. No external GPU exists, every transport number is a knob, and what is proven is the STATE MACHINE and THE SCOPE OF THE CHECK -- no hardware property.
THE DEVICE-SIDE DIGEST RATE IS UNMEASURED, so the D > R condition is derived and its answer for any real bridge is not established.
STILL NOT MODELLED, unchanged: a provider that corrupts CONSISTENTLY IN BOTH DIRECTIONS so every digest agrees with itself, and any adversary who can recompute a crc32 or observe the sealed identity.
